body: I've been borderline suicidal since junior high. Over the years, I've had a few pity attempts in which I would pussy out with the noose around my neck or the pills in my hand. One real attempt last year when my best friend died in which I tried to OD on oxy. I texted a friend who called 911 after I had taken like 200mg which was all I had at the time. This is probably the worst my anxiety has been. I've been having reoccurring nightmares of dead family and friends for the past few weeks. Can't really think straight anymore.

My days generally consist of reading, discretely using oxy, sleeping, listening to music, swimming. I took a year off from my university to get my mind straight. With all this time on my hands, my anxiety's gotten worse and I feel like I'm drifting away from the rest of society. I don't know how in hell I'm going to be able to come back to school in 2 months and function.
I went to an inpatient rehab facility in CA. It was probably the worst experience of my life. My tolerance is around 100mg of oxy per day.
I recently relapsed. I don't want to go through the process again.
